new_libraries.name: MyDesktopWidget
new_libraries.author: Lucas Riechelmann Ramos
new_libraries.sentence: Show live PC stats from MyDesktopWidget on an ESP32 screen.
new_libraries.paragraph: Subscribe to the PC's sensors (CPU, GPU, temperatures, network, media) over USB and draw them however you like. Requires MyDesktopWidget on Windows.

new_libraries.name: VectorUtilities
new_libraries.author: Christoph Streit <christoph.streit@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: 2D and 3D vectors and smooth motion curves for robots, games and animation.
new_libraries.paragraph: Vector2 and Vector3 classes with operators, dot and cross products, rotation about any axis, projection and reflection, plus the curves that move things smoothly: lerp, smoothstep, minimum jerk, quadratic and cubic Bézier, and a time-constant low-pass filter. Float only, with constexpr constructors so constant tables cost no RAM. Derived from raylib's raymath.
